name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

modelCreationJobOptions.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for the distributed creation of
{@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s, which will subsequently be trained.

modelEvaluationSpec.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link MlModel.Evaluation.Spec} that should be used for the distributed classification of trained
{@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s

doNotClassify.description:
Specify whether to classify the models after they are trained. By default this field is set to False,
meaning models will be classified after training.

doNotValidate.description:
Specify whether to validate the models after they are trained. By default this field is set to False,
meaning models will be validate after training.

modelValidationJobOptions.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for the distributed validation of
{@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s, if {@link #doNotValidate} is set to Fals.e

doNotGenerateValidationReports.description:
Specify whether to generate model validation reports for the models after they are trained. By default
this field is set to False, meaning that model reports will be generated after model validation.
NOTE: If this field is set to False, then the {@link #doNotValidate} field MUST also be False.

modelReportingJobOptions.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for the distributed generation of
{@link ReliabilityMlModelReport}s, if {@link #doNotGenerateValidationReports} is set to False.

doNotRegister.description:
Specify whether to register models into the model registry service after they are trained. By default this field
is set to False, meaning models will be registered after training.

registerModelsJobOptions.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for the distributed registering of
models into the Model Registry service.

pipelineSpecs.description:
The {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelTrainingPipeline}s that should be used to create,
train and deploy {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s.
If specified, it will take precedence over any specified {@link #modelTrainingJob} or {@link #trainedModels}.

trainedModels.description:
Use this field to directly specify trained {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s that will then be deployed and also classified,
if {@link #doNotClassify} is set to False.

assetFilter.description:
Specify which {@link ReliabilityAsset}s to train the {@link PipelineSpec} on by passing in a {@link Filter}.
The function will extract the latest {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} for each
{@link ReliabilityAsset} and use it to train the {@link PipelineSpec}.

datasetPreparationRunFilter.description:
Use this field to directly specify which {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}s to use to train models. If
specified, it will override the {@link assetFilter}.

jobSpec.description:
The {@link MlModel.Train.JobSpec} that should be used to create the {@link MlModel.Train.Job} that will train
the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s.

title:
An interface for creating a {@link Workflow} that starts the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel} training routine.
This {@link Workflow} will create a {@link MlModel.Train.Job} that will train {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s
for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s specified in {@link #assetFilter} or {@link #datasetPreparationRunFilter}.
The {@link Workflow} will then classify the trained models, validate the models, generate model reports, and
register the models into the Model Registry service.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelTraining
